parent_objective: design bounded weighted trainable-scope repeat using M1306 plan
blocked_by: M1306 produced an admissible plan but no weighted repeat protocol exists
supersedes: direct weighted trainable-scope implementation without process design

public_gates: M1307 must preserve actor input contract
M1307 must not use private holdout
M1307 must define how split-plan and group weights enter the next probe
M1307 must require branch synthesis before any larger training or PPO step
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train in the design milestone

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the bounded weighted repeat protocol from the M1306 admissible plan
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design admits PPO directly
stop if design omits group-weight caps
stop if design does not route to synthesis before implementation or larger training
fallback_plan: if weighted repeat design is feasible, route to branch synthesis before implementation
if design is too narrow, route to branch synthesis and pivot
if the plan cannot be used cleanly, route to source corpus expansion
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: tenth milestone in trainable-scope escalation branch; next milestone must synthesize before implementation or PPO

allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1307 designs fixed-current source-history weighted diagnostics only; it does not evaluate closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: preserve correct-history versus wrong-history diagnostic rows
preserve pair-disjoint fold evaluation and group-level weights
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If weighted design cannot avoid public-row overfit, route to branch synthesis and pivot before implementation.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: The M1306 admissible plan can be converted into a bounded no-PPO weighted fusion_head repeat protocol with clear pass/fail gates and synthesis before implementation.
success_criteria: design specifies group-weight usage and caps
design requires branch synthesis before implementation or PPO
design keeps PPO and promotion blocked
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, pair-specific weighting, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design omits split-plan or group-weight usage
thresholds are relaxed after seeing results
decision_rule: M1307 passes if it designs a bounded weighted repeat protocol and requires branch synthesis before any implementation, larger training, PPO, promotion, private holdout use, threshold relaxation, pair-specific weights, or actor-input expansion.
